name: TerraFusion MCP Integration Contract
description: Validation contract for MCP PostGIS server integration

violations.message: MCP server is not responding or cannot be reached
violations.resolution: Check server process, network connectivity, and firewall settings

automation.command: ps aux | grep mcp-postgis-server && curl http://localhost:3100/health

violations.message: PostGIS query failed or returned invalid results
violations.resolution: Validate database schema, check spatial indexes, verify PostGIS version

automation.command: psql -d terrafusion_os -c 'SELECT PostGIS_Version(); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM properties WHERE geometry IS NOT NULL;'

violations.resolution: Verify database credentials, user permissions, and connection limits
CREATE INDEX idx_properties_geometry ON properties USING GIST(geometry)

automation.command: psql -d terrafusion_os -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'properties' AND indexdef LIKE '%gist%'"
automation.autofix: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_properties_geometry ON properties USING GIST(geometry)

violations.message: Invalid or corrupt geometry data detected

automation.command: psql -d terrafusion_os -c 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM properties WHERE NOT ST_IsValid(geometry)'
automation.autofix: UPDATE properties SET geometry = ST_MakeValid(geometry) WHERE NOT ST_IsValid(geometry)

violations.resolution: Optimize query, increase timeout, or run ANALYZE on tables

violations.message: Query returned more results than allowed limit
violations.resolution: Refine query parameters or increase MAX_QUERY_RESULTS
violations.details: Default limit is 1000 results per query

violations.resolution: Verify input parameters match tool schema requirements
examples: parcel_search requires either parcelId or address

violations.message: PostGIS extension is not installed or enabled
violations.resolution: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis

automation.autofix: psql -d terrafusion_os -c 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis'

violations.message: Expected MCP tool is not registered in server
violations.resolution: Verify server startup and tool registration code

validations.name: server_health_check
validations.description: Verify MCP server is running and responsive

validations.name: spatial_index_exists
validations.description: Verify spatial index on properties table
validations.command: psql -d terrafusion_os -t -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'properties' AND indexdef LIKE '%gist%'"

validations.name: tool_registration
validations.description: Verify all required tools are registered
